node_notes.i2c: This shared I2C1 bus is initialized and scanned at application startup. firmware/configs/app_config.h binds SCL to PB8 and SDA to PB9, and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c configures those alternate-function pins.
node_notes.tim3: TIM3 provides the free-running microsecond counter used to measure DHT22 response and data edges. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c configures and starts TIM3.
node_notes.usart: USART2 is the serial link used by logging and climate-frame transmission. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c configures PA2/PA3 as USART2 signals and transmits through HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.logport: This adapter connects portable logging to the USART2 platform writer. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c calls platform_uart2_init and platform_uart2_write.
node_notes.decoder: This portable module checks the DHT22 checksum and value ranges before returning temperature and humidity. The implementation is dht22_decoder_decode in firmware/modules/dht22_decoder.c.
node_notes.uartport: This HAL adapter initializes USART2 and transmits the climate frame and logs. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c configures PA2/PA3 and uses HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.logger: This formatter prefixes log records and sends them through the platform logging contract. firmware/utils/logger/logger.c formats records and calls logger_platform_write.
node_notes.vcp: The USART2 adapter targets the board's ST-LINK Virtual COM Port, which is the console output sink. This is specified in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.h and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c.
node_notes.climate: This service enforces the minimum sampling interval and maps platform results into climate readings and statuses. firmware/services/climate_service.c implements climate_service_init and climate_service_poll.
node_notes.dhtport: This STM32 adapter implements DHT22 timing and GPIO operations, then passes the captured frame to the decoder. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_dht22.c drives and reads PB4 and uses TIM3 for edge timing.
node_notes.dht: The DHT22 communicates using the bidirectional single-wire data line on PB4. firmware/configs/app_config.h identifies PB4 and firmware/app/app.c describes DHT22 sampling there.
node_notes.app: This application entry performs the I2C scan, initializes climate sampling, polls readings, and emits climate frames. The evidence is app_start, app_report_i2c_scan, and app_poll_climate in firmware/app/app.c.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as Cube main
  participant App as app_start
  participant I2C as I2C1 PB8/PB9
  participant Service as climate_service
  participant Port as DHT22 platform port
  participant Sensor as DHT22 PB4
  participant Timer as TIM3
  participant Log as logger
  participant UART as USART2 PA2/PA3
  participant VCP as ST-LINK Virtual COM Port
  Boot->>App: call app_start
  App->>I2C: i2c_bus_init
  alt I2C initialization succeeds
    App->>I2C: i2c_bus_scan address range
    I2C-->>App: ACK addresses and NACK count
    App->>Service: climate_service_init
    Service->>Port: climate_port_init
    Port->>Sensor: Configure PB4 as released input
    Port->>Timer: Initialize and start TIM3
    Port-->>Service: initialization status
    alt Climate initialization succeeds
      loop app_start polling loop; samples at least 2000 ms apart
        App->>Service: climate_service_poll
        Service->>Port: climate_port_read
        Port->>Sensor: Drive start-low pulse, release line, read frame edges
        Port->>Timer: Read counter for edge timing
        Sensor-->>Port: Response and 40 data bits
        Port->>Port: Decode and validate DHT22 frame
        Port-->>Service: Reading or acquisition error
        alt Climate reading is valid
          Service-->>App: Temperature and humidity
          App->>Log: LOGI reading
          Log->>UART: HAL UART write through logger adapter
          App->>App: Format CLIMATE frame
          alt Formatted frame length fits buffer
            App->>UART: platform_uart2_write climate frame
          else Frame length invalid
            App->>App: Skip climate frame transmission
          end
        else Climate poll failed
          Service-->>App: Failure status
          App->>App: Invalidate reading and emit LOGE
          App->>UART: Log output through USART2
        end
      end
    else Climate initialization fails
      App->>Log: LOGE initialization failure
      App->>App: Spin forever
    end
  else I2C initialization fails
    App->>Log: LOGE initialization failure and return
  end
